title: loft theme pack
description: theme.json (the core) and manifest.json of a Loft theme pack. See docs/THEME-FORMAT.md.

wallpaperItem.description: A wallpaper: a path (relative to the pack, or absolute), or {path, video?, preview?} for a still that stands for a video.

path.description: The image the shell shows (a video here is listed but flagged: the image layer can't play it)

video.description: The video this still was taken from

wallpaperSet.description: A multi-display arrangement: wallpapers by display role (not connector) and optionally per workspace. Paths are relative to the pack (or absolute).

name.description: Unique in the pack; shown in Settings → Wallpaper → Sets

displays.description: role → image. A display takes the first of its roles the set has: its position (main = the largest display; left/right/top/bottom of it, left-2 … further out), its shape (portrait, ultrawide ≥ 2.2:1, landscape), its ordinal display-1..N (by x), then * (any)

workspaces.description: workspace → image: a niri workspace name, or <role>#<idx> (e.g. main#2: the main display's second workspace)

name.description: Unique in the pack; vibes refer to it as <pack>:<name>. Default: metadata.desktop's Name, else the pack name (or the locks/<dir> name)

format.description: loft: Main.qml against docs/THEME-FORMAT-LOCK.md. qylock: an SDDM-API QML theme dir (metadata.desktop, theme.conf, MainScript). Default: qylock when the dir has metadata.desktop. studio: the old name of loft (studio-linux packs), read as loft

path.description: Directory relative to the pack (or absolute)

preview.description: A screenshot for pickers (default: preview.* / screenshot.* in the design dir)

vibeRefs.description: <pack>:<file> (wallpapers) / <pack>:<lock name> (locks), or <pack> for all of that pack's. Resolved when that pack is installed; missing ones are skipped.

palette.description: Semantic roles every component reads. Extra #rrggbb entries pass through to consumers.

ansi.description: Optional explicit 16 terminal colors; derived from the palette when absent.

blur.description: Compositor blur behind glass; false turns niri blur off entirely

xray.description: Blur the wallpaper only (cheap) instead of what is really behind

terminalOpacity.description: Terminal background opacity (default 0.85 with blur, 1 without)

shadow.description: Focused window shadow (default #00000066 dark / #0000002e light); inactive windows get a fainter one

edgeDarken.description: Darkened inner rim of glass surfaces (default 0.35 dark / 0.18 light)

specular.description: Top specular highlight of glass surfaces (default 0.5 dark / 0.75 light)

image.description: The default wallpaper: path relative to the pack (copied into the rendered bundle) or absolute. Default: the first still of images / wallpapers/

images.description: The rest of the collection, after image; files in the pack's wallpapers/ dir follow these

wallpaperSets.description: Multi-display wallpaper arrangements (docs/THEME-FORMAT.md, Wallpaper sets). The shell applies the one covering the most displays on a multi-display layout while the user has made no choice for the theme.

fonts.description: Declaring fonts makes terminals use them too.

shape.description: Corner radii (px). One radius for every window: niri windows and the shell's own.

windowRadius.description: Every window (niri window rule + the shell's windows). Default: radii.window, else 12

adaptiveText.description: Text and icons turn light or dark with the wallpaper under the bar

background.description: Draw the glass strip behind the bar (Golden Gate: no background)

upstream.description: Set by importers: where the pack was converted from.

ref.description: The ref that was requested (HEAD = default branch)

path.description: Theme directory inside the upstream repo

lock.description: The default lock screen / greeter design (shorthand for a first entry of locks). Absent: lock/Main.qml when present, else the first of locks, else the built-in design colored by the palette.

locks.description: More lock designs shipped in the pack (directories under locks/ are picked up too).

vibes.description: Curated links to other packs' wallpapers and lock designs that match this pack's vibe.
